$comment: The single source of the data-* and data-nz-* vocabulary (ARCHITECTURE.md §8.2, §8.3). It feeds stateAttrs(), the stylelint allowlist, the emitted-CSS check, the conformance check that parts carry nothing outside it, and the docs page. engineDom() does not read it: it drops every engine data-* attribute except those in each adapter's dom-allowlist.json (ARCHITECTURE.md §9.3 rule 6). Semver'd: removing or renaming an entry or a value is breaking. An entry with "presence": true is a presence attribute (data-open=""); otherwise "values" lists the allowed values. "values": null means the value set is defined per component manifest. Engine sources (for example React Aria render state) live in each adapter, not here.

state.name: data-entering
state.meaning: Enter transition running; the node stays mounted until it ends

state.name: data-exiting
state.meaning: Exit transition running; the node stays mounted until it ends

state.name: data-side
state.meaning: Resolved physical side after flip and RTL; the side prop takes logical values

state.name: data-highlighted
state.meaning: Keyboard or virtual focus, or pointer hover

state.name: data-checked
state.meaning: Checked, where no native input exists

state.name: data-indeterminate
state.meaning: Mixed, where no native input exists

state.name: data-pressed
state.meaning: Pointer or keyboard press (native parts use :active)

state.name: data-focus-visible
state.on: parts with virtual or programmatic focus

state.name: data-invalid
state.meaning: An error message is currently presented (not "fails constraints"); always the Field's own state, never the engine's

state.name: data-pending
state.meaning: Data lifecycle: pending (§16.5); also an action in flight on Button and SubmitButton

presentational.name: data-slot
presentational.meaning: The part's class minus the nz- prefix (data-slot="select-trigger"); a part is documented when it has a data-slot

presentational.name: data-variant
presentational.meaning: The variant prop; values are the lowercase Figma names in each component manifest

presentational.name: data-size
presentational.meaning: The size prop; values in each component manifest

presentational.name: data-tone
presentational.meaning: The tone prop; values in each component manifest

presentational.name: data-full-width
presentational.meaning: The fullWidth prop: the control fills the inline size of its container

presentational.name: data-gap
presentational.meaning: The gap prop: a --nz-space-* step; values in each component manifest

presentational.name: data-span
presentational.meaning: The span prop: columns spanned, mobile first and clamped to --nz-grid-columns; values in the Grid manifest

presentational.name: data-span-sm
presentational.meaning: The span prop's value from --nz-sm; values in the Grid manifest

presentational.name: data-span-lg
presentational.meaning: The span prop's value from --nz-lg (provisional); values in the Grid manifest

presentational.name: data-ratio
presentational.meaning: The ratio prop: an aspect-ratio preset (§14.3); values in the Image manifest

local.name: data-sort
local.meaning: Current sort direction of the column

local.name: data-interactive
local.on: card, row with a stretched link

local.name: data-range-start
local.meaning: First date of the selected range

local.name: data-range-end
local.meaning: Last date of the selected range

local.name: data-platform
local.meaning: Platform the glyph is drawn for; value set fixed in the Kbd manifest

local.name: data-x-direction
local.meaning: The chart's xDirection prop: axes do not mirror by default (ltr); rtl and auto are opt-in (§14.1)

local.name: data-focus-inset
local.meaning: a11y-floor opt-out: draw the focus outline inside the part (outline-offset -2px), for clipped scrollers such as DialogBody and table cells (§8.5)

local.name: data-hit-inset
local.meaning: a11y-floor opt-out: no enlarged ::after hit area on this .nz-hit-target (§8.5)

scope.name: data-nz-theme
scope.setBy: the app on <html>, or any subtree

scope.name: data-nz-motion
scope.meaning: Force reduced motion in the subtree

scope.name: data-nz-scheme
scope.meaning: Inverse surface scheme for the subtree

scope.name: data-nz-touch-targets
scope.setBy: app opt-in for hybrid touch laptops

scope.name: data-nz-bottom-bar
scope.setBy: the shell, in a layout effect
scope.meaning: A bottom bar is present; offsets toasts and sticky bars

scope.name: data-nz-top-layer
scope.meaning: Element stays interactive above modal overlays
